$comment: The authorized-workbook policy. Not a secret, and deliberately so.
`spreadsheetIdSha256` is the SHA-256 digest of the one Google spreadsheet
this project may read. The identifier itself is supplied through the
GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID environment variable and is never committed;
a digest cannot be reversed into it.
While the digest is null every Sheets operation refuses: the connector
fails closed, not open. To pin it, set the environment variable and run
`corepack pnpm sheets:pin`, which prints the digest and nothing else, then
paste that digest here in its own reviewable commit.
Authorizing a different workbook is therefore a code change a human
reviews, not a configuration change anyone can make.
title: Cyberattack Sunday - RSS Intake
note: Shared with the dedicated service account as Viewer, on this one file. Revocation is removing that share.
